name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months to eligible landholding farmer families across India via DBT.

eligibility.description: Applicant must be a landholding farmer family owning cultivable land
Must possess cultivable land ownership recorded in land revenue records

benefits: ₹6,000 annually payable in 3 four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
application_steps: Visit official portal pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar Number and select State to verify record.
Fill in farmer personal details, bank IFSC, and land khata/khasra details.
Upload land record documents and submit for State Nodal Officer verification.
Track application status using Aadhaar number on the 'Know Your Status' tab.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

eligibility.description: Annual household income must be within SECC low-income criteria or registered BPL/Ration card limit

benefits: Cashless and paperless access to medical services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals nationwide.
application_steps: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in by entering mobile number or Ration Card ID.
Visit the nearest Ayushman Mitra kiosk at an empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Provide Aadhaar card and Ration Card for biometric e-KYC authentication.
Receive the Ayushman Golden Card (e-Card) for cashless hospital treatments.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Statutory guarantee of 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

eligibility.description: Must reside in a rural area and be 18 years or older

benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of unskilled manual wage work per financial year per rural household, with equal wages for men and women, paid directly via DBT.
application_steps: Submit written or oral application to the local Gram Panchayat for Job Card registration.
Gram Panchayat verifies household residence and issues a Job Card with photo within 15 days.
Submit a dated written demand for work specifying period of employment desired.
Gram Panchayat must provide work within 15 days, or pay statutory unemployment allowance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion ensuring universal access to banking facilities with zero minimum balance bank accounts, debit cards, and credit facilities.

eligibility.description: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above who does not have a basic savings bank deposit account

benefits: Zero minimum balance savings account, free RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, and overdraft (OD) facility up to ₹10,000.
application_steps: Visit any commercial bank branch, regional rural bank, or authorized Bank Mitra kiosk.
Fill out the PMJDY account opening form.
Provide official valid identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, NREGA job card).
Account opened instantly with RuPay debit card issuance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor and low-income households without existing LPG connection.

eligibility.description: Applicant must be an adult woman (18+) from a BPL/deprived household with no LPG connection

benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free first cylinder refill, free hotplate (stove), and targeted financial subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder.
application_steps: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or collect Ujjwala 2.0 application form at local LPG distributor (Indane, BharatGas, HP Gas).
Submit Ration Card, Aadhaar of applicant & adult family members, bank account details, and address proof.
LPG distributor verifies de-duplication and installs connection at home.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Government-backed small deposit savings scheme for girl children offering high compound interest and full tax exemption under Section 80C.

eligibility.description: Account can be opened by parents/guardians for a girl child from birth until she turns 10 years of age, maximum 2 accounts per family.

benefits: Attractive government-notified interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a. compounded annually), EEE tax exemption, and partial withdrawal allowed at age 18 for higher education.
application_steps: Visit any authorized Post Office or designated public/private commercial bank branch.
Submit SSY Account Opening Form (Form SSA-1).
Attach Girl Child's Birth Certificate and Parent/Guardian Identity & Address proof (Aadhaar/PAN).
Deposit initial minimum amount (minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 lakh per financial year).
Receive SSY Passbook.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for cultivation expenses, post-harvest expenses, and allied agricultural activities.

eligibility.description: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs/JLGs of farmers including animal husbandry and fisheries

benefits: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at a concessional interest rate of 7% p.a., reduced to 4% p.a. with 3% prompt repayment subvention (PRI).
application_steps: Download the one-page KCC application form from pmkisan.gov.in or visit the bank branch managing PM-KISAN account.
Fill in land survey number, crop sown details, and submit land revenue record (Khasra/Khatauni).
Bank processes and issues Kisan Credit Card within 14 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against financial losses from natural calamities, pests, droughts, floods, and unseasonal rainfall.

eligibility.description: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas (loanee and non-loanee farmers)

benefits: Full sum insured payout for crop loss with very low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
application_steps: Apply through National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), bank branch, or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Submit land possession certificate/Sowing certificate, bank passbook, and Aadhaar card before the seasonal cutoff deadline (July 31 for Kharif, Dec 31 for Rabi).
Insurance certificate generated with policy coverage details.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Provides collateral-free loans to micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises across manufacturing, trading, and service sectors.

eligibility.description: Small entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, artisans, and micro enterprises with credit requirements up to ₹20 lakh

benefits: Collateral-free loans in 4 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh), and Tarun Plus (₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh).
application_steps: Apply online on the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, NBFC, or MFI.
Submit business plan, proof of business identity/address, quotation of machinery/inventory, and Aadhaar card.
Bank assesses loan request and disburses loan with Mudra Card.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Guaranteed monthly pension scheme administered by PFRDA primarily targeted at unorganised sector workers.

eligibility.description: Minimum joining age is 18 years
Maximum joining age is 40 years. Must have savings bank account and not be an income-tax payer.

benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60 until death, followed by same pension to spouse and return of accumulated corpus to nominee.
application_steps: Visit the bank branch or post office where your savings bank account is maintained.
Fill out the APY Registration form choosing monthly pension tier (₹1,000 - ₹5,000).
Provide Aadhaar and nominee details and enable monthly auto-debit facility from bank account.
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) acknowledgment.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.

eligibility.description: Street vendors vending in urban areas with Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)

benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans in 3 tranches: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000 (1 year tenure), 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000, and 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000, with 7% interest subsidy and cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.
application_steps: Apply online on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through the PM SVANidhi mobile app.
Enter mobile number linked with Aadhaar and enter OTP.
Select Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) status.
Choose preferred lending institution and submit application for loan sanction.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit conditional cash transfer scheme providing wage compensation to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health and nutrition.

eligibility.description: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first child, and for the second child if the second child is a girl.

benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 in a single installment upon birth of a second girl child.
application_steps: Register at the local Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility within 270 days of LMP (Last Menstrual Period).
Fill out Form 1A with Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card details, Aadhaar, and bank account details.
Cash incentive disbursed directly via DBT upon completing ante-natal check-up (ANC) and child immunization.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Holistic end-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspersons working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.

eligibility.description: Artisans/craftspersons working in one of 18 traditional family-based trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, mason, tailor, etc.) aged 18+ with no existing central credit scheme default

benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest (₹1 lakh first tranche, ₹2 lakh second tranche).
application_steps: Register at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and biometric verification.
Select your traditional trade from the 18 eligible trades list and submit bank details.
Three-step verification: Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification, District Implementation Committee screening, and National Steering Committee approval.
Attend 5-day skill training, receive ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, and access credit support.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.

eligibility.description: Farmers, traders, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) registered in e-NAM integrated APMC mandis

benefits: Transparent online price discovery, access to nationwide buyers, free assaying/quality testing facilities, and direct online payment into farmer bank accounts.
application_steps: Register online at enam.gov.in or at the e-NAM gate entry of any integrated APMC mandi.
Submit land details, Aadhaar card, bank passbook, and mobile number.
Bring produce to mandi for electronic weighing, quality assaying, and lot creation.
Receive online bids from buyers across India, accept highest bid, and receive direct payment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Provides free foodgrains to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).

eligibility.description: All beneficiaries covered under NFSA ration cards (AAY households and PHH individuals)

benefits: Free foodgrains (rice/wheat/coarse grains): 5 kg per person per month for Priority Households (PHH) and 35 kg per family per month for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families at zero cost.
application_steps: Hold a valid NFSA Ration Card (AAY or Priority Household).
Visit the nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS / Ration Shop) anywhere in India using One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC).
Authenticate biometrically via e-PoS device and collect allocated free monthly foodgrains.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Flagship scheme for focused and sustainable development of the fisheries sector with total estimated investment of ₹20,050 crore.

eligibility.description: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, self-help groups, and fisheries entrepreneurs

benefits: Financial assistance (40% subsidy for general category, 60% for SC/ST/women) for procuring deep-sea fishing vessels, biofloc units, recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS), cold storage, and fish kiosks.
application_steps: Submit Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) / Project Report on the PMMSY portal or to the District Fisheries Office.
Include cost estimates, land/water body ownership or lease documents, and beneficiary details.
District Level Committee screens and State Fisheries Department sanctions project subsidy.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Placement-linked skill development program for rural youth from poor households under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).

eligibility.description: Rural youth aged 15 to 35 years (upper age limit 45 years for women, SC/ST, and persons with disabilities)

benefits: 100% free residential/non-residential skill training, free uniforms, study materials, tablet PC, and guaranteed minimum 70% placement with regular monthly salary above minimum wage.
application_steps: Enroll on the Kaushal Panjee portal (kaushalpanjee.nic.in) or visit the nearest DDU-GKY Training Centre / Gram Panchayat.
Select desired vocational trade (Retail, IT, Hospitality, Healthcare, Logistics).
Undergo skill training, assessment, and receive placement in an organized enterprise.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS - NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Provides one-time lump sum financial assistance to a bereaved BPL family on the death of the primary breadwinner.

eligibility.description: BPL household whose primary breadwinner (male or female) aged between 18 and 59 years dies

benefits: One-time lump sum financial assistance of ₹20,000 paid to the surviving head of the household.
application_steps: Submit application on the NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or to the local Block Development Officer (BDO) / Municipality.
Submit Death Certificate of the deceased breadwinner, BPL Certificate / Ration Card, Age proof (showing age 18-59 at death), and bank passbook.
Lump sum grant ₹20,000 disbursed directly into the surviving applicant's bank account.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Aims to provide Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) delivering 55 litres per capita per day of potable drinking water to every rural household.

eligibility.description: All rural households, village schools, anganwadis, and community centres across India

benefits: Safe, adequate, and regular tap water connection at household level delivering prescribed quality (BIS 10500 standards) water with zero individual infrastructure cost.
application_steps: Implemented through Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSC) and Gram Panchayats.
Village Action Plan (VAP) is prepared with community participation.
Pipeline infrastructure and household meter/tap connections installed by executing agency.
Track village tap water supply status on the JJM dashboard (ejalshakti.gov.in).

name: Stand Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

eligibility.description: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur aged 18+ setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading

benefits: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore covering up to 85% of total project cost with lowest applicable interest rate.
application_steps: Register on standupmitra.in or visit any scheduled commercial bank branch.
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR), enterprise location details, caste certificate (if SC/ST), and KYC documents.
Bank processes loan application and provides handholding support through SIDBI/NABARD.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers providing a monthly assured pension of ₹3,000 from age 60.

eligibility.description: Unorganised worker (home-based workers, street vendors, rag pickers, domestic workers, agricultural workers) aged 18-40 with monthly income <= ₹15,000 and not covered under EPFO/ESIC/NPS or income tax
Maximum joining age is 40 years

benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60, with equal 50:50 matching contribution paid by the Central Government.
application_steps: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Passbook / Jan Dhan Account.
Monthly contribution amount (₹55 to ₹200 depending on entry age) calculated automatically.
Initial contribution paid in cash at CSC; auto-debit mandate generated for subsequent months.
Receive unique PM-SYM Pension Card on the spot.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Non-contributory monthly social assistance pension for elderly citizens living below the poverty line.

eligibility.description: Person aged 60 years or above belonging to a household living below the poverty line (BPL)

benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 for persons aged 60-79 years, and ₹500 per month for persons aged 80 years and above, plus additional monthly top-up paid by respective State Governments.
application_steps: Apply online on the NSAP portal or through the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body / Block Development Office (BDO).
Submit BPL Certificate, Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID), and Bank Passbook.
PPO (Pension Payment Order) issued and pension credited monthly directly into bank/post office account via DBT.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS - NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Monthly pension support to destitute widows living below the poverty line.

eligibility.description: Widow aged 40 to 79 years belonging to a household living below the poverty line (BPL)

benefits: Central monthly pension of ₹300 per month (increased to ₹500 at age 80 under IGNOAPS), augmented by substantial State Government monthly contributions.
application_steps: Submit application at the local Panchayat / Municipal office or on nsap.nic.in.
Attach Husband's Death Certificate, BPL Card, Age Proof, and Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account details.
Verification conducted by Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Social Welfare Officer and monthly pension initiated.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS - NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Monthly social security pension for severely disabled persons living below the poverty line.

eligibility.description: Person aged 18 to 79 years with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or higher disability degree) belonging to a BPL household

benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 per month (₹500 after age 80) plus state-specific supplementary top-ups.
application_steps: Submit application on nsap.nic.in or at the District Social Welfare Office.
Provide Medical Board Disability Certificate (UDID card) showing >= 80% disability, BPL card, and bank details.
Direct Benefit Transfer of monthly pension into beneficiary bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Flagship skill certification scheme to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.

eligibility.description: Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts possessing Aadhaar card and bank account

benefits: 100% free short-term skill training, Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), government skill certification (NSQF aligned), and monetary post-placement stipend.
application_steps: Find an accredited PMKVY Training Centre on pmkvyofficial.org or Skill India Digital portal.
Enroll with Aadhaar, select preferred job role and training course.
Complete classroom training, practical assessment by third-party Sector Skill Council (SSC), and receive certificate.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Aims to extend the coverage of irrigation ('Har Khet Ko Pani') and improve water use efficiency ('Per Drop More Crop').

eligibility.description: Farmers owning cultivable agricultural land or members of Water User Associations / SHGs

benefits: 45% to 55% financial subsidy for installing micro-irrigation systems (drip irrigation and sprinkler systems), construction of farm ponds, and check dams.
application_steps: Register on the State Agriculture/Horticulture Department micro-irrigation portal or PMKSY website.
Submit land ownership documents (7/12 extract / Khasra), soil & water test report, and bank details.
Em-panelled micro-irrigation agency installs drip/sprinkler system on farm; subsidy released after physical inspection.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Grameen (SBM-G)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Aims to accelerate sanitation coverage in rural areas to sustain Open Defecation Free (ODF Plus) status through toilet construction and solid/liquid waste management.

eligibility.description: Rural households without individual household latrines (BPL families and identified APL SC/ST/women-headed households)

benefits: Direct financial incentive of ₹12,000 for constructing an Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) with twin-pit design.
application_steps: Apply online on sbm.gov.in or through the Gram Panchayat Secretary.
Upload photo of applicant, Aadhaar card, and first page of bank passbook.
Construct toilet and upload geo-tagged photograph; ₹12,000 incentive credited directly to bank account via DBT.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes agricultural mechanization among small and marginal farmers and in regions with low farm power availability.

eligibility.description: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers seeking modern farm machinery

benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹1.25 lakh for power tillers, rotavators, seed drills, harvesters) and up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
application_steps: Register on the Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization portal (agrimachinery.nic.in).
Select agricultural implement/machinery and authorized dealer.
Upload land documents, Aadhaar, and caste certificate; receive subsidy approval and delivery of machinery.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Affordable accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability coverage for all savings bank account holders aged 18 to 70.

eligibility.description: Minimum age is 18 years
Maximum age is 70 years with an active savings bank account

benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability, and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability, for an annual premium of just ₹20 auto-debited once a year.
application_steps: Log into Internet Banking or visit the branch where your savings account is held.
Fill out the PMSBY auto-debit consent form.
₹20 premium deducted automatically every year in May/June.
Policy certificate generated instantly.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: One-year renewable life insurance scheme offering life cover on death of the insured due to any reason (illness, natural, or accidental).

eligibility.description: Minimum age is 18 years
Maximum enrollment age is 50 years (coverage continues up to age 55)

benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to the nominee on the death of the insured member due to any cause, for an annual premium of ₹436.
application_steps: Visit bank branch or submit online auto-debit consent form through Net Banking.
Provide nominee details and declaration of good health.
₹436 annual premium auto-debited annually in a single installment.
Receive insurance acknowledgment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Provides financial assistance to homeless rural households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses for building a pucca house with basic amenities.

eligibility.description: Identified beneficiary in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list living in zero, one, or two-room kutcha house

benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas, plus 90-95 person-days of MGNREGA wages (₹25,000+) and ₹12,000 toilet grant under SBM-G.
application_steps: Beneficiaries selected from SECC 2011 / Awaas+ database and validated by Gram Sabha.
Gram Panchayat registers geo-tagged photograph of old kutcha house using AwaasApp.
First installment (₹40,000) transferred directly via DBT to start foundation.
Subsequent installments released after physical verification and geo-tagging at plinth and roof levels.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Addresses urban housing shortage among EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Groups by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban families.

eligibility.description: EWS (income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (income ₹3-6 lakh), MIG (income ₹6-9 lakh) with no pucca house anywhere in India in any family member's name

benefits: Up to ₹2.5 lakh central assistance for Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) / Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), and upfront interest subsidy of up to ₹1.80 lakh under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).
application_steps: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or through the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Enter Aadhaar details and select application component (BLC, AHP, or CLSS).
Upload income certificate, land ownership documents (for BLC), and bank account details.
Track assessment status using Application ID.

name: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Old age pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) providing assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon attaining age 60.

eligibility.description: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land up to 2.00 hectares aged between 18 and 40 years
Maximum entry age is 40 years
Land holding must not exceed 2.00 hectares

benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 from age 60 onwards. In case of death of pensioner, spouse receives 50% monthly family pension (₹1,500). Central government pays 50% matching monthly contribution.
application_steps: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or register on maandhan.in.
Provide Aadhaar card, PM-KISAN bank account details, and land khasra/khatauni records.
Monthly contribution (₹55 to ₹200) can be auto-debited directly from PM-KISAN bank account.
Kisan Pension Card generated instantly.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
description: Flagship direct financial assistance scheme providing ₹2,000 per month to the recognized woman head of every eligible family in Karnataka.

eligibility.description: Woman listed as the head of family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration card in Karnataka. Neither woman nor husband can be an income tax or GST payer.
Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka

benefits: Monthly cash assistance of ₹2,000 transferred directly to the woman head's Aadhaar-linked bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
application_steps: Apply through Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) or visit Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra.
Provide Ration Card number (BPL/AAY/APL) showing applicant as head of family.
Provide Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-seeded bank account details.
SMS acknowledgment sent and ₹2,000 monthly disbursement begins.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Maharashtra
description: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month to eligible adult women in Maharashtra to promote financial independence and nutrition.

eligibility.description: Married, widowed, divorced, or destitute women aged 21 to 65 years with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh residing in Maharashtra
Minimum age is 21 years
Maximum age is 65 years
Combined family annual income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh

benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,500 deposited directly into beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT.
application_steps: Download the 'Nari Shakti Doot' mobile app or visit ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in.
Register using mobile number and enter Aadhaar details.
Upload Domicile Certificate (or 15-year Ration card / voter ID) and Income Certificate.
Submit bank account details linked with NPCI Aadhaar mapper.
Track status and receive monthly disbursement.

name: Delhi Free DTC Bus Travel (Pink Ticket)
ministry: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
description: Universal free public bus travel for women commuters on all Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) and Cluster buses across the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

eligibility.description: Applicable for all female passengers travelling on DTC and DIMTS cluster buses

benefits: 100% fare waiver on all standard, low-floor, and AC DTC/Cluster buses via single-journey Pink tickets.
application_steps: Board any DTC or DIMTS cluster bus in Delhi.
Inform the bus conductor that you are requesting a women's single journey Pink Ticket.
Conductor hands over the free ₹10/₹15/₹25 face-value Pink Ticket immediately.
No advance registration, pass card, or identity document is required.
